# Synthetic Item 28A fixtures

`item-28a-cases.json` applies small, declared mutations to
`../logical-schema/item-28a-extra-pickup-facts.json`. All records are synthetic;
they contain no names, addresses, identifiers, accounts, signatures, or hidden
document metadata.

The suite covers the approved `INT-0001` scope only: rate-cycle boundaries,
zero/one/multiple occurrences, self-storage-only exclusion, performance and
Government-authorization evidence gates, duplicate rejection, exact-decimal
multiplication, and result-contract tampering.
